SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: name
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: The name of the catalog item.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: description
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: The description of the catalog item. Markdown and HTML may be used.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: hideDefaultDescription
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: If true, then no generic default description will be displayed if description is undefined.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: nameInCatalog
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: The name of the item to be displayed in the catalog, if it is different from the one to display in the workbench.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: info
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: Human-readable information about this dataset.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: infoSectionOrder
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: An array of section titles defining the display order of info sections. If this property is not defined, {@link DataPreviewSections}'s DEFAULT_SECTION_ORDER is used

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: isOpenInWorkbench
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: Whether the item in the workbench open or collapsed.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: shortReport
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: A short report to show on the now viewing tab.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: shortReportSections
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: A list of collapsible sections of the short report

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: isExperiencingIssues
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: Whether the catalog item is experiencing issues which may cause its data to be unavailable

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: hideSource
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: Indicates that the source of this data should be hidden from the UI (obviously this isn't super-secure as you can just look at the network requests).

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: metadataUrls
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: Metadata URLs to show in data catalog.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: dataUrls
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: Data URLs to show in data catalog.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: dataCustodian
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: Gets or sets a description of the custodian of this data item.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: modelDimensions
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: This provides ability to set model JSON through SelectableDimensions (a dropdown). When an option is selected, the value property will be used to call updateModelFromJson(). All string properties support Mustache templates (with the catalog member as context)

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: disableAboutData
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: Disables the 'About Data' button in the workbench.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: shareable
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: True (default) if this catalog member may be included in share links. False to exclude it from share links.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: workbenchControlFlags
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: Flags for enabling or disabling workbench controls.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: excludeMembers
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: An array of strings of excluded group and item names (or ids). A group or item name (or id) that appears in this list will not be shown to the user. This is case-insensitive and will also apply to all child/nested groups

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: includeMembersRegex
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: A regular expression that is matched against the member names and ids. Only members (groups and items) that match against the regular expression will be shown to the user. This is case-insensitive and will only apply to the first level of members (not in nested groups). This is applied before excludeMembers.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: isOpen
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: True if this group is open and its contents are visible; otherwise, false.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: mergeGroupsByName
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: Merge member groups by name.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: sortMembersBy
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: Sort members by the given property/trait. For example name, will sort all members by alphabetically

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: members
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: The members of this group.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: displayGroup
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: Allow adding all members to the workbench with one click. Show Add All / Remove All button

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: itemProperties
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description:
Sets traits on group member items (note - will not set traits to sub-groups). This applies to all nested group members (eg members in sub-groups). Also see itemPropertiesByType and itemPropertiesByIds.
Item properties will be set in the following order (highest to lowest priority) itemPropertiesByIds, itemPropertiesByType, itemProperties.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: itemPropertiesByType
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description:
Sets traits on group member items by model type (eg csv or geojson). This applies to all nested group members (eg members in sub-groups). Only one itemProperties can be specified per type.
Item properties will be set in the following order (highest to lowest priority) itemPropertiesByIds, itemPropertiesByType, itemProperties.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: itemPropertiesByIds
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description:
Sets traits on group member items by model ID. This applies to all nested group members (eg members in sub-groups). Only one itemProperties can be specified per id.
Item properties will be set in the following order (highest to lowest priority) itemPropertiesByIds, itemPropertiesByType, itemProperties.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: legends
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: The legends to display on the workbench.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: legendBackgroundColor
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: Apply background color to all legends. This can be useful if legends are transparent and clash with Terria colours

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: hideLegendInWorkbench
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: Whether the legend is hidden in the workbench for this catalog member.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: modelOverrides
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: This provides ability to override Dataflow dimensions by concept or codelist ID (full URN). For example, setting a default value for a given concept. Codelist overrides take priority over concept overrides. TODO add example

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: url
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: The base URL of the file or service.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: forceProxy
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: Force the default proxy to be used for all network requests.

SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.name: cacheDuration
SdmxCatalogGroupTraits.description: The cache duration to use for proxied URLs for this catalog member. If undefined, proxied URLs are effectively cachable forever. The duration is expressed as a Varnish-like duration string, such as '1d' (one day) or '10000s' (ten thousand seconds).

InfoSectionTraits.name: content
InfoSectionTraits.description: The content of the section, in Markdown and HTML format. Set this property to null to remove this section entirely.

InfoSectionTraits.name: contentAsObject
InfoSectionTraits.description: The content of the section which is a JSON object. Set this property to null to remove this section entirely.

InfoSectionTraits.name: show
InfoSectionTraits.description: Indicates if this info section showing (not collapsed).

ShortReportTraits.name: show
ShortReportTraits.description: Indicates if this short report section showing.

MetadataUrlTraits.name: url
MetadataUrlTraits.description: The metadata URL of the file or service.

MetadataUrlTraits.name: title
MetadataUrlTraits.description: Title used for metadata URL button.

DataUrlTraits.name: type
DataUrlTraits.description:
Type of data URL. This value will be used to provide context or instruction on how to use the data URL. For example wcs will provide a link to WCS docs.
Current supported values are:
- wfs = A Web Feature Service (WFS) base URL
- wcs = A Web Coverage Service (WCS) base URL
- wfs-complete = A complete, ready-to-use link to download features from a WCS server
-  wcs-complete = A complete, ready-to-use link to download features from a WFS server
-  direct = Direct URL to dataset (this is the default if no type is specified)
-  none = Hide data URL

DataUrlTraits.name: url
DataUrlTraits.description: The metadata URL of the file or service.

DataUrlTraits.name: title
DataUrlTraits.description: Title used for metadata URL button.

DimensionOptionTraits.name: value
DimensionOptionTraits.description: Value (if this is undefined, id will be used)

ItemPropertiesByTypeTraits.name: type
ItemPropertiesByTypeTraits.description: The type of model to apply itemProperties to. This must be defined.

ItemPropertiesByTypeTraits.name: itemProperties
ItemPropertiesByTypeTraits.description: Sets traits on group member items of specified type. This applies to all nested group members (eg members in sub-groups)

ItemPropertiesByIdTraits.name: ids
ItemPropertiesByIdTraits.description: The IDs of models to apply itemProperties to.

ItemPropertiesByIdTraits.name: itemProperties
ItemPropertiesByIdTraits.description: Sets traits on group member items of specified id. This applies to all nested group members (eg members in sub-groups)

LegendTraits.name: title
LegendTraits.description: A title to be displayed above the legend.

LegendTraits.name: url
LegendTraits.description: The URL of the legend image. If the URL suffix isn't one of the following png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg, then urlMimeType must be defined - otherwise a hyperlink will be shown.

LegendTraits.name: imageScaling
LegendTraits.description: Scaling of the legend. For example, a high DPI legend may have scaling = 0.5, so it will be scaled down 50%

LegendTraits.name: urlMimeType
LegendTraits.description: The MIME type of the URL legend image. For example "image/png"

LegendTraits.name: backgroundColor
LegendTraits.description: Apply background color to entire legend. This can be useful if legend is transparent and clashes with Terria colours. This will override legendBackgroundColor.

LegendItemTraits.name: title
LegendItemTraits.description: The title to display next to this legend item.

LegendItemTraits.name: multipleTitles
LegendItemTraits.description: Multiple titles to display next to this legend item.

LegendItemTraits.name: maxMultipleTitlesShowed
LegendItemTraits.description: Maximum number of multiple titles to display next to this legend item. (Default is 10)

LegendItemTraits.name: titleAbove
LegendItemTraits.description: The title to display above this legend item, i.e. marking the top of a box on the legend.

LegendItemTraits.name: titleBelow
LegendItemTraits.description: The title to display below this legend item, i.e. marking the bottom of a box on the legend.

LegendItemTraits.name: color
LegendItemTraits.description: The CSS color to display for this item. This property is ignored if Legend URL is specified.

LegendItemTraits.name: outlineColor
LegendItemTraits.description: The CSS color with which to outline this item.

LegendItemTraits.name: outlineWidth
LegendItemTraits.description: The width of outline in pixels

LegendItemTraits.name: outlineStyle
LegendItemTraits.description: The style of outline using CSS outline-style values. Eg 'dotted', 'dashed', 'solid', 'double', 'groove', 'ridge', 'inset', 'outset'

LegendItemTraits.name: multipleColors
LegendItemTraits.description: Multiple colors to show with this item in a grid arrangement.

LegendItemTraits.name: imageUrl
LegendItemTraits.description: The URL of an image to display with this item.

LegendItemTraits.name: marker
LegendItemTraits.description: Maki marker ID to display with this item (eg "circle").

LegendItemTraits.name: rotation
LegendItemTraits.description: The degrees to rotate legend item.

LegendItemTraits.name: addSpacingAbove
LegendItemTraits.description: True to add a bit of extra spacing above this item in order to separate it visually from the rest of the legend.

LegendItemTraits.name: imageHeight
LegendItemTraits.description: The height of the legend image.

LegendItemTraits.name: imageWidth
LegendItemTraits.description: The width of the legend image.

ModelOverrideTraits.name: type
ModelOverrideTraits.description:
Override concept/dimension type - Possible values are:
- 'region': values contain region codes used for region mapping - eg Country code)
- 'region-type': values contains region types - eg 'CNT2' which is 2-letter country codes)
- 'unit-measure': values should be used to describe primary-measure (eg in chart title)
- 'unit-multiplier': multiply primary-measure value by atrtibute values
- 'frequency': value used to determine time period frequency (ie. yearly, monthly...)

ModelOverrideTraits.name: regionType
ModelOverrideTraits.description: If type has been specified as 'region', you can also manually specify the region type (eg SA2 for ABS Statistical Area 2)

ModelOverrideTraits.name: regionTypeReplacements
ModelOverrideTraits.description: If type has been specified as 'region' and this dataflow contains multiple regionTypes - you can add a map to correct automatically detected region types. For example: setting regionTypeReplacements = [{find: 'SA1_2016', replace: 'SA1_2011'}] will replace regionType with SA1_2011 if it was SA1_2016
